markup.[[x]]: 重点形式：这个语法要你注意的词（橙底）
markup.{x}: 变化的部分：只用在 [[ ]] 里，例如 work{s}（橙底里加粗下划线）
markup.((x)): 变回原形的动词（虚线下划线）
markup.~~x~~: 错句里错的部分（删除线）

idea.title: 一句话说清
idea.text: used to 说的是**「以前常这样，现在不这样了」**，像在翻老照片：以前住哪、以前爱干嘛。would 也能讲以前**反复做**的事。

uses.zh: 以前的习惯，现在没有了
uses.en: I [[used to]] ((drink)) three coffees a day.
uses.en_zh: 我以前一天喝三杯咖啡。（现在不了）

uses.en: We [[used to]] ((live)) in a tiny flat.
uses.en_zh: 我们以前住在一间很小的公寓里。
以前每年夏天，我们都会去海边。

positive.title: 肯定句
positive.rule: **used to + 动词原形**，所有人都一样。动作、状态都能用。它只说过去，现在的习惯不用它。

examples.en: She [[used to]] ((write)) Objective-C, but now she uses Swift.
examples.zh: 她以前写 Objective-C，现在用 Swift。

notes: used to 读作 /ˈjuːstə/，中间的 d 几乎听不到。

negq.title: 否定和疑问
negq.rule: 否定用 didn't use to，疑问用 Did … use to？**d 只能出现一次**：did 已经是过去了，use 就不加 d。

examples.zh: 你上学的时候常踢足球吗？

notes: 口语里也常说 never used to：I <<never>> [[used to]] ((eat)) breakfast.（我以前从不吃早饭。）

would.title: would：讲以前反复做的事
would.text: 回忆往事时，would 可以代替 used to，讲**以前一次次重复的动作**。但它**不能讲状态**：住在哪、有什么、喜欢什么。

items.rule: 反复的动作：可以用 would
items.en: On Fridays, my dad [[would]] ((take)) us for fish and chips.
items.zh: 以前每周五，爸爸都会带我们去吃炸鱼薯条。

items.rule: 反复的动作：可以用 would
items.en: After work, we [[would]] ((play)) table tennis for hours.
items.zh: 以前下班后，我们会打好几个小时乒乓球。
我以前有一辆红色自行车。（不说 I would have）

items.rule: 讲故事：先用 used to 开头，后面接 would
items.en: We [[used to]] ((visit)) my gran every summer. She [[would]] ((bake)) scones for us.
items.zh: 我们以前每年夏天都去看外婆，她会给我们烤司康饼。

beused.title: 长得像的 be used to
beused.text: **be used to + 动词 ing（或名词）** 意思完全不同：「**已经习惯了**」，而且能说现在。别被长相骗了。

items.rule: used to + 原形：以前常这样
be used to + ing：现在已经习惯了
get used to + ing：慢慢变习惯
items.en: I'm still [[getting used to driving]] on the left.
items.zh: 我还在慢慢习惯靠左开车。

this.meaning: used to：以前常这样，现在不这样了

that.meaning: 一般过去时：只说发生过，可以只有一次

this.meaning: used to + 原形：以前常这样

that.meaning: be used to + ing：现在已经习惯了

commonMistakes.why: 肯定句里要写 used，带 d。
did 已经带了过去，use 不加 d。

commonMistakes.bad: I ~~would have~~ a dog when I was a kid.
commonMistakes.good: I [[used to]] ((have)) a dog when I was a kid.
commonMistakes.why: 有一只狗是状态，不能用 would。
be used to 后面接 ing。

commonMistakes.bad: I ~~usually go~~ to the gym, but I stopped last year.
commonMistakes.good: I [[used to]] ((go)) to the gym, but I stopped last year.
commonMistakes.why: 现在不去了，说以前的习惯用 used to。

quiz.prompt: I ___ three coffees a day, but now I only have one.
quiz.explain: 以前常这样，现在不这样了：[[used to]] ((drink))。

quiz.prompt: 翻译：我们以前住在一间很小的公寓里。
quiz.answer: We used to live in a tiny flat.
accept: We used to live in a small flat.
We used to live in a very small flat.
We used to live in a tiny apartment.
We used to live in a small apartment.

quiz.prompt: This street ___ (be) really quiet, but now it's full of cafés.
quiz.explain: 以前的状态，现在变了：[[used to]] ((be))。

quiz.prompt: 改错：I use to work for a bank.
quiz.answer: I used to work for a bank.

quiz.prompt: 改成否定句：I used to like coffee.
quiz.answer: I didn't use to like coffee.
accept: I did not use to like coffee.
I never used to like coffee.

traps.input: I didn't used to like coffee.
traps.note: didn't 后面用 use，不加 d。

quiz.explain: I [[didn't use to]] ((like))：d 只能出现一次。

quiz.prompt: 改成一般疑问句：You used to play football.
quiz.answer: Did you use to play football?

traps.input: Did you used to play football?
traps.note: did 已经带了过去，use 不加 d。

quiz.prompt: 针对划线部分提问：She used to live in Leeds.（问「在哪里」）
quiz.answer: Where did she use to live?

traps.input: Where did she used to live?
traps.note: did 后面用 use，不加 d。

options: When I was a child, I would have a red bike.
When I was a child, I used to have a red bike.
quiz.answer: When I was a child, I used to have a red bike.
quiz.explain: 有一辆自行车是状态，只能用 [[used to]]。

quiz.prompt: Every summer, my gran ___ (bake) scones for us.（用 would）
quiz.explain: 以前反复做的动作，可以用 [[would]] ((bake))。

quiz.prompt: 改错：I would have a dog when I was a kid.
quiz.answer: I used to have a dog when I was a kid.

quiz.prompt: I've lived in London for ten years, so I ___ the noise.
quiz.explain: 现在已经习惯了：I [[am used to]] the noise。

quiz.prompt: I'm still getting used to ___ (drive) on the left.
quiz.explain: get used to 后面接 ing：[[getting used to driving]]。

quiz.prompt: 改错：I'm used to work late.
accept: I am used to working late.
quiz.explain: be used to 后面接 ing：I[['m used to working]]。
<<yesterday>> 只说了一次，用一般过去时：I [[went]]。

quiz.prompt: I ___ to the gym a lot, but I stopped last year.
quiz.explain: 以前常去，现在不去了：[[used to]] ((go))。

quiz.prompt: 翻译：我已经习惯早起了。
quiz.answer: I'm used to getting up early.
accept: I am used to getting up early.
I'm used to waking up early.
I am used to waking up early.
quiz.explain: 现在已经习惯：I[['m used to getting]] up early。

openTask.prompt: 用 used to 说 3 件你以前常做、现在不做了的事（比如上学时、刚工作时）。至少一句否定或疑问，再试一句 would。
rules: 否定和疑问用 didn't use to / Did … use to，use 不加 d
would 只讲反复的动作，不讲状态
openTask.note: 规则判 used to / use to 和 would 的用法（计分）；离线模型给更自然的说法（AI 建议，不计分）
